mechanism: In turn 1 the model paired each filer's 2021 and 2022 year-end rates by joining or pivoting on (cik, name) instead of CIK alone. Four sponsors that changed their registrant name between the two 10-Ks (ViacomCBS/Paramount Global, Anthem/Elevance Health, Discovery/Warner Bros. Discovery, Cigna Corp/Cigna Group) therefore had no match, which cut the cohort from 124 to 120 (119 valid instead of 123). Later turns kept that cohort, giving 108 rather than 112 gain filers and 104 rather than 108 funded filers, so the duration came out at 9.1609 instead of 9.0457, the start funded ratio at 0.9523 instead of 0.9495, and the improved count at 69 instead of 71.
